app.name: BimaSaathi
app.tagline: Understand your health insurance, in your language

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.busy: We are busy right now. Please retry in a minute.
errors.fileType: Please upload a PDF, JPG or PNG file.
errors.fileSize: File is too large. Maximum size is 15 MB.
errors.signedOut: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.offline: You are offline. Check your internet connection. Your work is kept and will continue when you are back online.
errors.notFoundBody: This address does not exist. Let us take you back to the start.
errors.crashTitle: Something went wrong on this screen
errors.crashBody: Nothing is lost. Please try again.

disclaimer.general: BimaSaathi explains your policy but is not medical, legal or financial advice, and does not guarantee any claim. Confirm with your insurer.
disclaimer.privacy: Upload only sample or anonymised policies. The free AI tier may use inputs to improve Google products.

home.title: Upload your policy
home.subtitle: We read it once and explain it in simple words.
home.hint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 15 MB
home.sampleNote: Uses a built-in sample, so no personal data is needed.
home.how1: Upload your policy or take a photo
home.how2: We read it once and keep only the details
home.how3: Get it explained in your language

server.title: Server is waking up
server.body: The free server sleeps when unused and can take up to a minute to start. Please wait, your work is safe.
server.failedBody: Check your internet connection, then try again.

auth.title: Sign in to continue
auth.subtitle: Sign in with Google so your policies stay private to you.
auth.demoNote: Google sign-in is not set up yet, so the app runs with sample data only.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.anonymise: Remove names, policy numbers and phone numbers before uploading.
consent.p1: We read your policy once with Google’s Gemini AI and keep only the extracted details, never your original file.
consent.p2: On the free AI tier, Google may use what you upload to improve its products.
consent.p3: BimaSaathi explains policies. It is not medical, legal or financial advice and cannot guarantee a claim.
consent.agree: I understand and agree to upload only sample or anonymised policies.

processing.title: Reading your policy
processing.subtitle: This usually takes under a minute. Please keep this page open.
processing.slow: This is taking longer than usual. The free AI service may be busy. Please keep waiting or try again in a minute.
processing.errorTitle: We could not read this policy
processing.noIdBody: Upload a policy first, then we will show its progress here.

policy.title: Policy card
policy.waitingHint: You cannot claim for these until the waiting time is over.
policy.noIdBody: Upload a policy first, then it will appear here.
policy.tapHint: Tap an underlined word to see what it means.
policy.askCta: Ask a question about this policy

redFlags.title: Things to watch out for
redFlags.hint: These parts of your policy can reduce what you get paid.
redFlags.none: No red flags found in this policy.

audio.noVoice: No {{language}} voice is installed on this phone, so audio is not available. You can read the text below.
audio.unsupported: This browser cannot read text aloud. Please read the text on screen.
audio.error: Audio stopped because of a problem. Please try again.

ask.title: Ask your policy
ask.intro: Ask anything about your policy, for example “Is cataract surgery covered?”. Answers come only from your policy document.
ask.label: Your question
ask.fallback: The policy is not clear on this. Please confirm with your insurer.
ask.disclaimer: This is a general explanation of your policy, not medical, legal or financial advice. It does not guarantee a claim.

voice.errPermission: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone in your browser settings, or type your question.
voice.errNoSpeech: We did not hear anything. Tap the microphone and try again.
voice.errLanguage: Voice input is not available for this language on your phone. Please type your question.
voice.errNetwork: Voice input needs an internet connection. Please try again or type.
voice.errMic: No microphone found. Please type your question.
voice.errGeneric: Voice input did not work. Please try again or type your question.

claim.title: Claim readiness check
claim.subtitle: Tell us about the hospital stay. We check it against your policy rules.

typeHelp.cashless: The insurer pays the hospital directly.
typeHelp.reimbursement: You pay first, then claim the money back.

claim.admissionHelp: The day you were or will be admitted to hospital.
claim.diagnosisHelp: For example: dengue, knee replacement, cataract.
claim.billHelp: An approximate total in rupees is fine.
claim.noPolicyBody: The claim check needs your policy. Upload it, then come back here.
claim.errDateInvalid: This date is not valid. Please check it.
claim.errDiagnosis: Please tell us the illness or treatment.
claim.errBillInvalid: Please enter a whole number of rupees, more than zero.
claim.errBillHigh: This amount looks too high. Please check it.
claim.docsHelp: Add clear photos of your papers, up to {{max}}.
claim.full: You have added the maximum of {{max}} photos.
claim.tooMany: {{count}} photo(s) not added. The limit is {{max}}.
claim.duplicate: {{count}} photo(s) skipped because you already added them.
claim.errDocType: Only JPG or PNG photos can be added here.
claim.errDocRead: Could not read {{name}}. Please try another photo.
claim.docsPrivacy: Photos are made smaller on your phone, checked once and not stored.
claim.needOne: Add at least one photo to continue.

result.title: Your claim result
result.scoreHelp: This shows how ready your papers and policy rules look. It is a guide to help you prepare.
result.noActions: Nothing urgent. Keep your papers safe.
result.rulesHelp: Each check comes from a fixed rule applied to your policy. The page and clause show where it comes from.
result.notGuarantee: This is a readiness check, not a guarantee of claim approval. Your insurer decides the claim.
result.copied: Copied. You can paste it in a message.
result.shareFailed: Could not share. Please try again.
result.shareText: My BimaSaathi claim readiness score: {{score}} out of 100. Do this first:
result.emptyBody: Run a claim check first, then your result will appear here.

compare.title: Compare policies
compare.subtitle: Put 2 or 3 policies side by side and see which one suits a hospital stay.
compare.scenarioHelp: We use these numbers to estimate what you would pay in each policy.
compare.daysHelp: How many days the patient stays.
compare.rentHelp: What the hospital charges for the room each day.
compare.billHelp: An approximate total in rupees is fine.
compare.errDaysMissing: Please enter the number of days.
compare.errRentMissing: Please enter the room rent per day.
compare.errRentInvalid: Please enter a whole number of rupees, more than zero.
compare.errBillInvalid: Please enter a whole number of rupees, more than zero.
compare.errBillHigh: This amount looks too high. Please check it.
compare.swipe: Swipe sideways to see all policies
compare.needTwoBody: You have {{count}} policy so far. Upload another one, then come back here.
compare.estimateNote: This is a simplified estimate from the numbers you entered and the policy rules. The insurer's final assessment can differ.
compare.adviceNote: Written by AI using only the numbers above. It adds no new numbers.

renewals.title: Renewals
renewals.subtitle: We remind you 30, 15, 7 and 1 day before each policy renews.
renewals.pushOff: Turn on notifications to get a reminder before your policy renews.
renewals.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for this site in your browser settings, then come back.
renewals.pushUnsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. On iPhone, first add BimaSaathi to your Home Screen. You can still add renewals to your calendar.
renewals.pushUnconfigured: Notifications are not set up in this demo version. You can still add renewals to your calendar.
renewals.pushFailed: Could not turn on notifications. Please try again.
renewals.pushNote: Notifications are free. We only send renewal reminders.
renewals.noMoreReminders: All reminders for this renewal are done.
renewals.calNote: Check your options before the policy renews.
renewals.testSent: Test reminder sent. Check your notifications.
renewals.testNotSent: The test could not be sent. Check that notifications are on.
renewals.testNeedPush: Turn on notifications above to send a test.
renewals.emptyBody: Upload a policy and its renewal date will show up here.

review.title: Review dashboard
review.subtitle: Claims ranked by a rule-based risk score, so a person can look at the riskiest ones first.
review.synthetic: Synthetic data: these are made-up claims for a demo. They are not real people or real claims.
review.humanNote: A score only points to claims that need a closer look. It is never a decision and it never labels a person. A human always decides.
review.reasonsTitle: Why this claim needs a closer look
review.noFlags: No rules were triggered for this claim.
review.noAuto: Nothing is rejected automatically. Your choice is the decision.
review.emptyBody: There are no claims in the queue right now.

settings.languageHelp: Choose the language you read best. It changes the whole app.
settings.notificationsBody: Renewal reminders are managed on the Renewals screen.
settings.privacyKeeps: We keep only the details read from your policy, your reminders and your claim check results. We never keep your original policy file or claim photos.
settings.deleteHelp: Delete everything BimaSaathi has saved about you. This removes your policies, reminders and results from our server and from this phone.

items.policies: Your saved policies and what was read from them

settings.confirmCheck: I understand and I want to delete all my data.
settings.deleteDoneBody: Everything was removed. You will now be signed out.
settings.insurerBody: A demo of the review dashboard. It uses made-up claims only.
settings.installBody: Add BimaSaathi to your phone like an app. It opens faster and full screen.
settings.installLater: No problem. You can install it any time from here.
settings.installIos1: Tap the Share button in Safari (the square with an arrow).
settings.installIos2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
settings.installIos3: Tap "Add". BimaSaathi appears on your Home Screen.
settings.installManual: Open your browser menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
